name: weatherxm-fact
description: WeatherXM FACT compares published historical forecast accuracy across 45 numerical and AI weather models against 8,927 physical WeatherXM ground stations across temperature, wind_speed, wind_direction (circular shortest-arc angular error in 0°–180° + >3 m/s active-wind rankings), precipitation (MAE/RMSE and rain-event HSS/POD/FAR/CSI), and humidity. Query local H3 cell benchmarks, country cell-win summaries, global and local head-to-head model error curves, and ground-truth publication coverage. The service requires no account. Coarse H3 query-demand telemetry is stored for coverage planning; see the privacy policy.

capabilities: Read published historical local forecast accuracy across 5 weather variables (including circular wind_direction)
Inspect global leaderboards (up to all 45 models) and country-level published cell-win summaries
Compare up to 10 forecast models head-to-head on global, country, or local H3 cell cohorts
Check historical ground-truth station publication coverage
defaultPrompt: Which weather forecast model is most accurate for Athens, Greece (37.98, 23.73)?
Compare the top weather forecast models for wind speed in Switzerland (CH).
Show forecast accuracy across lead times near Zurich (47.37, 8.54).

negative.description: Do not trigger for ecommerce order refunds or billing changes.
negative.prompt: Refund my last order and update my credit card billing address.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because order management and billing mutations are outside WeatherXM FACT's read-only forecast benchmark scope.

negative.description: Do not trigger for calendar scheduling or email sending.
negative.prompt: Schedule a 30-minute meeting with my team tomorrow at 10am and email the invite.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because calendar and email actions are unrelated to weather forecast model benchmarking.

negative.description: Do not trigger for smart-home thermostat or IoT device mutations.
negative.prompt: Set my living room thermostat to 22 degrees Celsius and turn off the porch lights.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin should not be invoked because it only provides read-only weather forecast model accuracy benchmarks and cannot control smart-home devices.
